concept: Coding and Decoding in Fictitious Language
question: In a certain code language, ‘how are you’ is written as ‘so me lo’, ‘you are intelligent’ is written as ‘the lo me’ and ‘are they lazy’ is written as ‘me ca ya’. How will ‘how are they’ be written in that language?
solution:
The code for each word is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0dd0d770a66e10a43533b7108dff2f7436161f1083f509047c7b16045e81235.png] 

How - so

are - me

they - ca/ya

So, the possible codes are: so me ca or so me ya

As 'so me ca' is available in the options, it will be the answer.

Hence, '**so me ca**' is the correct answer.
